purpose: Teach: かねて/余暇/車中/留まる/論拠/言い過ぎ/御用/競走

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: この件、本気で、絶対、かねて、絶対、から、絶対、検討、絶対、しておりましたね
lines.en: We've been giving this matter serious consideration for quite some time now, haven't we.
lines.style: Measured opening, businesslike but not cold. Steady pacing, slight upward lilt at the end—confirming shared ground rather than questioning. Composed posture in the voice.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社員の、本気で、絶対、余暇、絶対、充実、絶対、福利厚生で、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're advancing our staff welfare and benefits initiatives because we genuinely value our people's wellbeing.
lines.style: Warm formality. Gentle emphasis on the values underlying the initiative, not just the mechanics. Even pace. A note of quiet pride in the work being done.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 移動の、本気で、絶対、車中、絶対、で、絶対、議事録、絶対、確認しましょうか
lines.en: Should we review the meeting notes during the drive?
lines.style: Light, practical suggestion. Quick pace, forward-looking tone. Open and collaborative—checking in rather than directing. No tension.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。当社の方針、本気で、絶対、現状に、絶対、留まる、絶対、ことなく、絶対、進化しております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. Our company philosophy continues to evolve rather than stagnate in response to current conditions.
lines.style: Confident but not boastful. Steady conviction underneath. Slight emphasis on 'evolve'—this is something they're doing well. Professional warmth.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 企画の、本気で、絶対、論拠、絶対、十分か、絶対、確認しましょう
lines.en: Let's make sure the foundation for this initiative is solid.
lines.style: Focused, clear-eyed direction. Quick, no-nonsense delivery. Respectful but firm—setting the standard. Clean opening attack on the first word.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。メールでの、本気で、絶対、言い過ぎ、絶対、文面、絶対、修正、絶対、いたします、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I'll revise the email tone to make sure it lands as intended.
lines.style: Responsive and immediate. Acknowledges the point without defensiveness. Brisk, competent tone. Slight rise at the end—confirmation of action.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 王室御用達、本気で、絶対、御用、絶対、達ブランド、絶対、当社も、絶対、目指しましょう
lines.en: Let's set our sights on becoming a trusted, premium brand—the kind people reach for first.
lines.style: Aspirational but grounded. Slower, more deliberate pacing here—inviting them into the vision. Warmth and genuine belief in the goal. Light breathiness before the vision unfolds.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。業界、本気で、絶対、競走、絶対、激化、絶対、する中、絶対、当社、絶対、差別化、絶対、図っております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. As the industry competition intensifies, we're building real differentiation for ourselves.
lines.style: Final note of quiet confidence. Steady, accomplished tone. Slight fade into the closing—they've covered ground together. Warm professional closure.
